recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait featuring a central female figure with long blonde hair, wearing an intricate silver skeletal body piece, seated atop a life-sized horse sculpture entirely covered in mirrored glass tiles (disco ball mosaic). The scene is set against a void-like black background, emphasizing the reflective properties of the horse and the warm skin tones of the subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between organic human skin and cold, geometric mirrored surfaces
Interaction between sharp specular light flares on the horse and soft studio lighting on the figure
The horse as a luminous pedestal elevating the subject within a dark void
Symmetry of the horse's profile balanced by the subject's upright, frontal posture
coreInvariants: Mirror-tiled horse texture with visible grout lines
Star-burst light flares emanating from the horse's reflective surface
Silver metallic/crystal body jewelry as the primary garment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject and horse are centered horizontally, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central torso of the female figure, framed by the horse's back.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The viewer's eye starts at the bright light flares on the horse's chest, moves up to the subject's face, and follows the curve of the horse's back to the tail.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounds the central group, creating a sense of isolation and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (Background) provides the canvas for all light and color.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Silver/Chrome (Horse and Jewelry) provides high-frequency detail and brightness.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm Tan/Gold (Skin and Hair) provides the only organic color temperature.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white-hot highlights and the black background; low saturation except for the subject's skin.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution image of a woman with long blonde hair in a silver crystal body harness sitting on a horse made of disco-ball mirrors. The background must be pure black. Use studio lighting to create sharp highlights on the mirrors and soft light on the skin.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist, wide-tracked sans-serif font in white or silver, placed in the lower third or upper margin to avoid overlapping the central figure.

verificationChecks: Does the horse have a distinct mirror-tile texture?
Are there visible light flares on the horse's surface?

adjustableVariables: Intensity and number of light flares
Complexity of the silver body jewelry
mustRedesign: Avoid specific facial features of the original subject
Do not replicate specific jewelry patterns
Ensure the horse is a sculpture, not a biological animal

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of the figure and the sculpture
Clean, sharp edges against the black background
avoid: Generic 'glitter' effects instead of distinct mirror tiles

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness of the horse and figure
Ensure reflections on the horse include the subject's legs
Verify that light flares do not obscure the subject's face
Confirm the background is 100% black without noise
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person/Object] + Texture [Mirror Mosaic/Chrome] + Environment [Black Void] + Lighting [Specular Flares/Studio Soft] = High-Contrast Editorial Style.
